title: Floor Space Indices & BUA computation, Tenement Density and Protected Development

table_12_basic_fsi.description: Zone-wise permissible FSI by road width. Columns: zonal (basic), additional on premium, admissible TDR, permissible (sum).

industrial.note: TDR in I Zone only for I Zone uses excl. hazardous (per Reg 34.3 Table C)

special_zones.area: BARC (M Ward) + N Ward bounded by EE Highway/N-boundary/Thane creek/S-boundary
Aksa/Marve + CRZ-affected Erangal in P-North; Gorai/Manori in R Ward (excl. gaothan)

industrial.note: TDR in I Zone only for I Zone uses excl. hazardous

gross_plot_deductions.description: Areas deducted from gross plot before FSI computation (Reg 30(A)(2)).
deducted: Land under DP Roads / roads with sanctioned Regular line per MMC Act
Land to be surrendered to MCGM under Reg 14 (amenity plots)
Land to be surrendered to MCGM under Reg 15 (inclusive housing)
Land to be surrendered to MCGM under Reg 16 & 17
compensation: Additional BUA per Reg 32(1) Table 12(A) equal to surrendered area is allowed on remainder plot, over and above permissible BUA, OR can be availed as TDR
BUA equal to surrendered area can be utilized even before availing additional FSI on premium/TDR
If owner cannot consume even zonal FSI due to planning constraints, TDR is allowed for unconsumed BUA

premium_for_additional_fsi.utilization_note: Additional FSI on premium is non-transferable; must be used on same plot only
premium_for_additional_fsi.combination_note: Additional-FSI-premium and TDR can be used in any combination, subject to permissible FSI cap in Table 12 column 7

development_surcharge_cess.applies_to: BUA over and above Zonal (basic) FSI, excluding fungible compensatory area BUA
development_surcharge_cess.note: Not applicable to BUA handed over to MCGM/Appropriate Authority or excluded from FSI. Not applicable to Govt/MCGM departmental proposals.

tenement_density.note: Scales proportionally with FSI. Minimum applies only to plots ≥ 1 ha and sub-divided plots each ≥ 1 ha.

protected_development.description: Existing authorized BUA is protected during redevelopment; additional FSI as per applicable regulations may be availed on top.
protected_development.loss_of_protection: If user category (educational, medical, hotel, religious, IT) is discontinued during redevelopment, additional BUA from that category is not protected and premium already paid is not refundable.

fungible_reference: See Reg 31(3) — Fungible FSI Compensatory Area is over and above permissible FSI per Table 12 column 7
notes_from_source: Recreational open space (Reg 27) is NOT deducted from BUA/FSI computation.
If plot was previously affected by road/DP reservation and FSI benefit was already taken but ownership not transferred to MCGM, gross plot area is reckoned AFTER deducting such areas.
OC for last 25% of admissible FSI (res/com) granted only after recreational area is developed and structures completed.

For Central/State Govt/PSU (Atomic Energy, Civil Aviation, AAI, Defence, Railways, Mumbai Port Trust) certain areas are excluded from FSI calc: playgrounds, stadia, golf, parade/training/firing grounds, green areas in complexes, operational lands, major internal roads, railway tracks/yards, unauthorized reclaimed lands, airfield lands.
